sources.title: EngineCore.step：总组织者
sources.description: 调用 Scheduler.schedule，再发 execute_model，必要时发 sample_tokens，最后 update_from_output。batch queue 路径使用同样的主要对象，但跨 step 的等待顺序不同。
sources.snippet:
657      def step(self) -> tuple[dict[int, EngineCoreOutputs], bool]:
 658          """Schedule, execute, and make output.
 659
 660          Returns tuple of outputs and a flag indicating whether the model
 661          was executed.
 662          """
 663          # Check for any requests remaining in the scheduler - unfinished,
 664          # or finished and not yet removed from the batch.
 665          if not self.scheduler.has_requests():
 666              return {}, False
 667          scheduler_output = self.scheduler.schedule(self._should_throttle_prefills())
 668          future = self.model_executor.execute_model(scheduler_output, non_block=True)
 669          grammar_output = self.scheduler.get_grammar_bitmask(scheduler_output)
 670          with (
 671              self.capture_iteration_details(scheduler_output) as iteration_details,
 672              self.log_error_detail(scheduler_output),
 673          ):
 674              model_output = future.result()
 675              if model_output is None:
 676                  model_output = self.model_executor.sample_tokens(grammar_output)
 677
 678          # Before processing the model output, process any aborts that happened
 679          # during the model execution.
 680          self._process_aborts_queue()
 681          engine_core_outputs = self.scheduler.update_from_output(
 682              scheduler_output, model_output
 683          )

sources.title: step_with_batch_queue：流水化组织
sources.description: 队列有空位时继续调度并异步提交，队列满或暂时无新批次时回收较早的结果。不能把这段代码简化成每一步都先完全执行完再 schedule 下一步。
sources.snippet:
698      def step_with_batch_queue(
 699          self,
 700      ) -> tuple[dict[int, EngineCoreOutputs] | None, bool]:
 701          """Schedule and execute batches with the batch queue.
 702          Note that if nothing to output in this step, None is returned.
 703
 704          The execution flow is as follows:
 705          1. Try to schedule a new batch if the batch queue is not full.
 706          If a new batch is scheduled, directly return an empty engine core
 707          output. In other words, fulfilling the batch queue has a higher priority
 708          than getting model outputs.
 709          2. If there is no new scheduled batch, meaning that the batch queue
 710          is full or no other requests can be scheduled, we block until the first
 711          batch in the job queue is finished.
 712          3. Update the scheduler from the output.
 713          """
 714          batch_queue = self.batch_queue
 715          assert batch_queue is not None
 716
 717          # Try to schedule a new batch if the batch queue is not full, but
 718          # the scheduler may return an empty batch if all requests are scheduled.
 719          # Note that this is not blocking.
 720          assert len(batch_queue) < self.batch_queue_size
 721
 722          model_executed = False
 723          deferred_scheduler_output = None
 724          if self.scheduler.has_requests():
 725              scheduler_output = self.scheduler.schedule(self._should_throttle_prefills())
 726              with self.log_error_detail(scheduler_output):
 727                  exec_future = self.model_executor.execute_model(
 728                      scheduler_output, non_block=True
 729                  )
 730              if not self.is_mm_encoder_only:
 731                  model_executed = scheduler_output.total_num_scheduled_tokens > 0
 732
 733              if self.is_pooling_model or not model_executed:
 734                  # No sampling required (no requests scheduled).
 735                  future = cast(Future[ModelRunnerOutput], exec_future)
 736              else:
 737                  if not scheduler_output.pending_structured_output_tokens:
 738                      # We aren't waiting for any tokens, get any grammar output
 739                      # and sample immediately.
 740                      grammar_output = self.scheduler.get_grammar_bitmask(
 741                          scheduler_output
 742                      )
 743                      future = self.model_executor.sample_tokens(
 744                          grammar_output, non_block=True
 745                      )

sources.title: Scheduler.schedule：决定本 step 算什么
sources.description: 选择请求和 token 份额、申请 KV block、处理缓存相关约束。本函数主要产生计划，不执行 DeepSeek 的矩阵乘。AsyncScheduler 继承此 schedule，在后续更新钩子中增加异步状态管理。
sources.snippet:
591      def schedule(self, throttle_prefills: bool = False) -> SchedulerOutput:
 592          self.current_step += 1
 593          # NOTE(woosuk) on the scheduling algorithm:
 594          # There's no "decoding phase" nor "prefill phase" in the scheduler.
 595          # Each request just has the num_computed_tokens and
 596          # num_tokens_with_spec. num_tokens_with_spec =
 597          # len(prompt_token_ids) + len(output_token_ids) + len(spec_token_ids).
 598          # At each step, the scheduler tries to assign tokens to the requests
 599          # so that each request's num_computed_tokens can catch up its
 600          # num_tokens_with_spec. This is general enough to cover
 601          # chunked prefills, prefix caching, speculative decoding,
 602          # and the "jump decoding" optimization in the future.
 603
 604          scheduled_new_reqs: list[Request] = []
 605          scheduled_resumed_reqs: list[Request] = []
 606          scheduled_running_reqs: list[Request] = []
 607          preempted_reqs: list[Request] = []
 608
 609          req_to_new_blocks: dict[str, KVCacheBlocks] = {}
 610          num_scheduled_tokens: dict[str, int] = {}
 611          token_budget = self.max_num_scheduled_tokens
 612          spec = self.vllm_config.speculative_config
 613          draft_slots = spec.max_num_new_slots_for_drafting if spec is not None else 0
 614          input_budget = self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
 615          if self._pause_state == PauseState.PAUSED_ALL:
 616              # Do not schedule any requests when paused.
 617              token_budget = 0

279      def forward(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 280          hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids).unsqueeze(-2).repeat(1, self.hc_mult, 1)
 281          full_num_tokens = positions.shape[0]
 282          if self.use_sequence_parallel_moe:
 283              if envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING and is_forward_context_available():
 284                  forward_context = get_forward_context()
 285                  forward_context.is_padding = sp_padding_mask(
 286                      forward_context.is_padding,
 287                      hidden_states,
 288                  )
 289              hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
 290              input_ids = sp_shard(input_ids)
 291          pre_mix = hidden_states.new_zeros(hidden_states.shape[0], self.hc_mult, dtype=torch.float32)
 292          pre_mix[:, 0] = 1.0
 293          last_layer = None
 294          for layer in self.layers.values():
 295              last_layer = layer
 296              hidden_states, pre_mix = layer(
 297                  positions,
 298                  hidden_states,
 299                  pre_mix,
 300                  llama_4_scaling=None,
 301                  input_ids=input_ids,
 302              )
 303          assert last_layer is not None, "Hyper-connection collapse requires at least one decoder layer"
 304          hidden_states = last_layer.hc_collapse(hidden_states, pre_mix)
 305          if self.use_sequence_parallel_moe:
 306              hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[:full_num_tokens]
 307          return hidden_states
